text:
maya (PM): Final checklist for Observe launch tomorrow. Need crisp gates, owners, and rollback triggers.

liam (Eng): Summary risk: trace writes + CPU during error storms. Plan: sampling defaults + token-bucket limiter + bounded write buffer.

neda (SRE): On staging error burst hit trace_queue ~4k. Auto-throttle rule: if queue > 3.5k or trace_write_p95 >350ms -> throttle sampling and page.

irene (Platform): Canary config (defaults): error=100%, success=adaptive (5/1/0.1%), global_cap=170/min/region, REDACT_RULES=["email","account_id"]. Tenant opt-in required for full traces.

rachel (Solutions): Customers require per-tenant opt-in and a signed redaction attestation for FinCorp. They want CSV cost export + error cluster widget.

liam (Eng): Owners: dashboards=rachel, runtime=liam, platform=irene, ops=neda. Devs implement observe_flag canary -> 10% -> gating.

maya (PM): Acceptance gates to move 10%->50%:
- Dashboards: error-by-model & cost tile present and update within 3m
- Tracing: sampling honored; FinCorp redaction tests pass
- Perf: p95 console latency <= 630ms
- Ops: trace_queue < 3.5k and trace_write_p95 < 350ms
- Cost: rolling-2h delta <= 12% vs baseline

neda (SRE): Synthetic plan: 30m steady + 15m error spike. Fail if any gate breaches. I'll post logs.

maya (PM): Rollout plan: canary 10% -> observe 45m -> evaluate gates -> 50% for 2h -> finish. Immediate rollback on gate failure. Post dashboard links and evidence here during canary. :rocket:
